summary: Euroculture is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master's in European studies, culture and society. Students move between universities such as Göttingen, Groningen, Strasbourg, Udine, Olomouc, Kraków and Uppsala, with partners in Hyderabad, Canada, Mexico and Osaka. Scholarships pay full tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month for 24 months. Complete scholarship applications are due by 15 January 2027.
meta_title: Euroculture 2027: Erasmus Mundus European studies scholarship
meta_description: Euroculture pays tuition, insurance and €1,400 a month for a European studies master's across Göttingen, Groningen, Uppsala and more. Apply by 15 January 2027.
covers: A full tuition waiver. Self-funded non-EU students pay €5,000 a semester, €20,000 in all.
€1,400 a month for living costs for the 24 months.
eligibility: A bachelor's in a field such as international relations, European studies, history, cultural studies, liberal arts with a humanities profile, or theology. Degrees mainly in economics, psychology, management, business, accounting, engineering or the exact sciences are generally not accepted.
For a scholarship, proof of your completed degree must be uploaded by 15 January 2027.

English: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 6.5, TOEFL iBT 93, PTE 71 (writing 61), Cambridge CAE or CPE, or LanguageCert 75. A bachelor's taught entirely in English exempts you; nationality alone does not.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Applications for 2027–2029 opened on 15 October 2026.

Upload your degree certificate, transcripts, English proof, an academic writing sample of at least 2,000 words, a CV, your passport and a photo, and name two referees, one academic. Referees must respond within two working weeks.
Submit the complete application by 15 January 2027. Scholarship results are expected by the end of March 2027.
watch_out: Ask your referees early: their letters are part of the complete application.
Self-funded non-EU applicants are advised to apply by 1 May 2027 and are assessed on a rolling basis.
documents: Academic writing sample of at least 2,000 words

faq.q: When is the Euroculture scholarship deadline?
faq.a: Complete applications are due by 15 January 2027. Results are expected by the end of March 2027.

faq.q: Can I apply to Euroculture with a business or engineering degree?
faq.a: Generally not. Degrees mainly in economics, psychology, management, business, accounting, engineering or the exact sciences are not considered suitable, unless they include substantial humanities coursework.

faq.q: Does an English-taught degree from Ghana exempt me from IELTS?
faq.a: Yes, if the whole bachelor's was taught in English. Nationality alone does not exempt you.
